payload.comment:
Data audit stage is clean: all 12 integrity checks pass (official split, indices, labels, pixels, shape, train/val disjointness), zero train/validation overlap, no blank images, no duplicates, and loaded split sizes match official values exactly (89996/10004/7180) with no subsampling. Archive MD5 and SHA256 verified; selected-index hashes present for all three splits. Class imbalance is modest (1.63×) and train/val proportions are closely aligned (max deviation <0.001). Deterministic torch is enabled with seed=42 and code hash recorded. The six augmentations in the representation plan (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) are all built-in primitives and do not require extension approval; the augmented train size of 629,972 (89,996 × 7) is arithmetically consistent. Normalization via standardization with train-set statistics is appropriate.

Warnings (non-blocking): (1) The extension gate lists tissue_geometric_aug as pending_review, but it comprises only built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip) that do not require extension approval per pipeline policy; this redundant gate entry should be cleared to avoid downstream confusion, but it does not invalidate the augmentation primitives. (2) compact_conv_stem_transformer is correctly gated as pending_review as a new architecture outside the seven built-in families; it must not be used in any training run until hash-bound independent review is completed. (3) Worker image_digest is null; verify it is populated before the training stage for full reproducibility audit trail. (4) isolation.enforced=false with local_subprocess execution is acceptable but noted for the reproducibility record. (5) All three prior-art sources are curated excerpts, not live retrieval; evidence quotes establish traceability only, not performance support—hypotheses remain unvalidated until empirical testing. (6) The representation plan rationale references a 'compact transformer' downstream architecture; if this maps to the pending compact_conv_stem_transformer proposal, training with that architecture is blocked until review completes, though the data audit itself is unaffected.

No deterministic findings. Compacted fields and the omitted prior_art_brief are preview truncations for this review, not incomplete persisted artefacts; no regeneration is requested. The data is verified, consistent, and ready to proceed to the next stage.
